description: Formal operational configuration definitions for CodeMind AI baselines (B0-B3), proposed system (P), and evaluation ablations (A1-A5).

B0.name: Zero Context
B0.description: No repository retrieval. Only evaluate metrics for which B0 produces a comparable output; otherwise report N/A.

B1.name: Lexical Retrieval
B1.description: PostgreSQL lexical search (tsvector / keyword match) only.

B2.name: Hybrid Retrieval
B2.description: Lexical + semantic vector retrieval combined via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF). No reuse scoring, security gating, architecture evidence, or grounded selection.

B3.name: Retrieval + Basic Reuse
B3.description: Hybrid retrieval paired with naive syntactic similarity reuse scoring. Lacks multi-criteria 8D evaluation and hard security gating.

P.name: Proposed Complete System
P.description: Authoritative deterministic engine: Hybrid RRF retrieval, 8-dimensional multi-criteria reuse evaluation, hard security gating (CRITICAL/HIGH -> BLOCKED), architecture coupling intelligence, and bounded grounded reasoning evidence selection.

A1.name: P without Semantic Retrieval
A1.description: Ablates semantic vector search; relies solely on lexical retrieval in the hybrid stage.

A2.name: P without Reuse Scoring
A2.description: Ablates deterministic reuse evaluation; attempts unguided decision directly from top retrieved candidates.

A3.name: P without Security Gating
A3.description: Simulated evaluation ablation: removes hard security blocker (HIGH/CRITICAL severity no longer forces BLOCKED status) to measure safety degradation.

A4.name: P without Architecture Intelligence
A4.description: Ablates architecture coupling and cycle detection; evaluates reuse decisions without structural dependency penalties.

A5.name: P without Grounded Evidence Selection
A5.description: Ablates bounded evidence chunking and token optimization; injects unconstrained naive repository context.
